quote.text: Content yourself with being a lover of wisdom, a seeker of the truth. Return and return again to what is essential and worthy. Do not try to seem wise to others. If you want to live a wise life, live it on your own terms and in your own eyes.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace wisdom as the core of nurturing, guiding your children by the example of seeking essential truths rather than chasing external validation.
    • Let your daily interactions with your children reflect a pursuit of genuine understanding, fostering an environment where both you and they grow in character and discernment.
  • Leadership
    • Lead with authenticity by grounding your decisions in a relentless quest for truth, ensuring that your leadership is respected not for show, but for substance.
    • Your influence grows when you remain true to your principles, encouraging your team to focus on what is truly important rather than seeking superficial accolades.
  • Product Management
    • Approach product decisions with the mindset of distinguishing between fleeting trends and enduring value, always returning to what is essential for your users.
    • Build products that reflect a commitment to truth and wisdom, ensuring that each iteration is a step toward meaningful innovation rather than merely impressing others.
